blocks.text: INITAO, Misamis Oriental — To honor the sacrifice of a fallen local hero, Initao College here held on Friday, Oct. 9, the 7th PSMS Jason Magno Memorial Voluntary Blood Donation Drive. The annual event pays tribute to Senior Master Sergeant Jason Magno, who gave his life on Nov. 27, 2019, when he fell on a grenade to shield students and teachers from its explosion inside the campus. “Now in its seventh year, this annual blood donation drive serves as a meaningful tribute to PSMS Jason Magno, bringing together partners and community members in a shared commitment to saving lives through voluntary […]...
